name: TutorBench
summary: About 1,500 expert-written tutoring tasks in high school and AP STEM subjects, each with its own rubric, testing explanations, feedback on student work and hints.

license.note: The full dataset's card states no license; its 30-item samples are CC BY-NC 4.0.

cite: Srinivasa, R. S., Che, Z., Zhang, C. B. C., et al. (2025). TutorBench: A Benchmark To Assess Tutoring Capabilities Of Large Language Models. arXiv:2510.02663

fits.how: Its rubrics could rate replies in agent tests, once its license is clear.

connect.note: Its full dataset's license isn't stated and it comes only as Parquet. Not connected until its license is clear.
